headline: GOLD JUMPS 3%, SILVER SURGES 9% AS GOLD-SILVER RATIO HITS 83 — Precious Metals Reclaim Ground on Thin Thanksgiving Volume
snippet: Gold climbed 3.05% to $3,643.80 and silver surged 8.92% to $43.63 as the gold-silver ratio compressed to 83, with precious metals posting a sharp bounce during holiday-thinned Thanksgiving trading as short sellers covered positions.

headline: COPPER BACK ABOVE $12,000 AS SHORT SELLERS RETREAT — Tariff Fears Ease But JPMorgan Still Sees $11K BY 2027
snippet: LME copper climbed back above $12,000 per tonne after falling below $11,500 earlier in the week as short sellers retreated on easing tariff uncertainty; JPMorgan warned the recovery is fragile and maintains a 2027 price target near $11,000.

headline: TSX AND FTSE MINERS LEAD MARKETS HIGHER AS GOLD, COPPER SURGE — Sector Posts Best Single-Day Gain in Weeks
snippet: Canada's TSX and London's FTSE 100 both rallied on November 27 as broad metals strength boosted mining and energy stocks, with gold rising over 3% and silver nearly 9% on holiday-thin North American volume.

headline: USAR DOWN 27% IN A MONTH — CANACCORD SLASHES TARGET FROM $32 TO $10, KEEPS BUY RATING
snippet: USA Rare Earth (USAR) has collapsed 27% in a month to $6.52 as China extended mineral export controls and U.S. tariff risks mounted; Canaccord cut its price target from $32 to $10 but maintained a Buy rating on the long-term Western supply chain thesis.

headline: USAR +7%, MP MATERIALS +8% AS TRADERS EYE U.S.-CHINA RARE EARTH NEGOTIATIONS — Sector Trades as Binary Option On Chinese Curbs
snippet: Rare earth equities bounced sharply as speculation built around a potential Trump-Xi summit and U.S.-China rare earth trade talks; analysts warn the sector trades as a binary option on whether Beijing maintains or eases export restrictions.

headline: ELEMENT 29 RESOURCES LOCKS IN 3-YEAR SURFACE ACCESS AT FLOR DE COBRE COPPER PROJECT, PERU
snippet: Element 29 Resources (TSX-V: ECU) secured a 3-year surface access agreement at its Flor de Cobre copper project in Peru, clearing a critical permitting milestone and opening the door to advancing the project toward drill-ready status.

headline: MUNDORO CLOSES CENTERRA GOLD EQUITY INVESTMENT, APPOINTS NEW CFO — Q3 2026 RESULTS IN
snippet: Mundoro Capital (TSX-V: MUN) closed a strategic equity investment by Centerra Gold into its Serbian porphyry copper-gold program alongside Q3 results, while also appointing a new CFO, changing its auditor, and streamlining its board.

headline: BLUE GOLD EYES CRITICAL MINERALS TRADING PIVOT — Convertible Preferred Share Deal Said Under 5% Dilutive
snippet: Blue Gold is pursuing an international commodity trading diversification deal involving up to 2.5 million convertible preferred shares, with management characterising the transaction as less than 5% dilutive to current shareholders.

headline: GOLD RALLIES ON RISING RISK APPETITE — FXEmpire: Technical Breakout From Oversold Extreme Across Precious Metals
snippet: FXEmpire's metals forecaster notes gold, silver and platinum rallying on rising demand for risk assets, with charts pointing to a potential technical breakout after the complex hit a rarely-seen oversold extreme in mid-November.
